summary: Iteration 41 — Super Admin Console + Public Content frontend & backend tested end-to-end. ALL 9 requested test scenarios PASS. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (public content list/detail no-auth, super-admin analytics shape, users list/search/role-filter/active-filter, user deactivate→reactivate flow, deactivated demo.student login returns HTTP 403 'Account has been deactivated', orgs list). Frontend: /public loads without auth showing Cognify branding + hero + search + 5 category chips + 2 Summit Keynote cards each with Read/Audio/Video; clicking Read navigates to /public/:id which natively renders 2 slides ('Cognify Summit 2026' + 'Agenda') and shows Media versions sidebar with locked Audio narration / Video presentation + 'Sign in to unlock' CTA. Login as super admin auto-redirects /login → /super-admin. All 4 tabs work: Analytics (6 stat cards: 66 users, 5 orgs, 20 courses, 10 premade, 2 public, 2 quiz attempts + Users-by-role + Top-orgs + Refresh), Users (66 rows, search 'teacher'→11, role=teacher→16, active filter, Deactivate→toast 'User deactivated/reactivated' verified), Organizations (5 cards w/ users/active/courses + Active badge + Deactivate), Public Content (2 cards w/ delete/audio/video; Upload modal opens with Title/Desc/Category/File). Sidebar role-gating correct: super_admin sees Super Admin Console, Public Library, All Courses, Premade Docs, AI Mentor, Settings — NO 'My Assignments' or 'Gradebook'. Zero console errors throughout.

minor.issue: Returns some legacy users where is_active field is missing from the document (treated as None). Frontend defensively handles this via `u.is_active !== false`, so no UI impact. Suggest a one-time migration to set is_active=true on any legacy user docs missing the field.
Org objects do not include a top-level `is_active` field; UI defensively defaults missing → active. Backend should add is_active to org response payload for consistency with the user payload.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Add is_active=true to organization API response payload for symmetry with users payload — UI works either way.
(Optional, low-priority) One-shot DB migration to set is_active=true on any legacy user docs missing the field.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicContentPage.js correctly fetches /api/public/content unauthenticated, renders 2 Summit Keynote cards with category badges, Read/Audio/Video CTAs, and a working search + 5 category chips (All/Summit Presentations/Public Resources/Keynotes/Workshops).

PublicContentViewPage.js renders slides_json natively via the same white-card layout used by PremadeCoursesPage (iter-40) — no auth required, shows lock icons + 'Sign in to unlock' on the Media versions sidebar.

SuperAdminDashboardPage.js: Analytics correctly reads from `response.summary` shape; all 6 stat cards populated from live DB (66/5/20/10/2/2). Users-by-role & Top-organizations breakdowns render correctly.

Users tab: search debounces on Enter, role filter sends `role=`, active filter sends `is_active=true/false`, toggle button calls the correct deactivate/reactivate endpoint and shows the appropriate toast ('User deactivated' / 'User reactivated').

Login flow correctly issues HTTP 403 with message 'Account has been deactivated. Please contact support.' when an inactive user attempts auth — verified live by deactivating demo.student → attempting login → 403 → reactivating → 200.
DashboardPage.js auto-redirect: super_admin role users hitting /dashboard or /login are forwarded to /super-admin without flicker.
Sidebar.js role-based filtering excludes student/teacher-only nav items (My Assignments, Gradebook, etc.) for super_admin role — confirmed by DOM inspection.
Zero console errors across Public listing, Public view, Super Admin Analytics/Users/Orgs/PublicContent tabs, and Upload modal.
